description: This file defines various dropout modules for neural networks in PyTorch, including standard dropout, dropout variants for 1D, 2D, 3D inputs, and specialized alpha dropout modules, with detailed docstrings and class implementations.

classes.name: _DropoutNd
classes.description: Base class for dropout modules with common functionality for N-dimensional dropout.

classes.name: Dropout
classes.description: Standard dropout module that randomly zeroes elements of the input tensor during training.

classes.name: Dropout1d
classes.description: Dropout variant for 1D feature maps, zeroing out entire channels.

classes.name: Dropout2d
classes.description: Dropout variant for 2D feature maps, zeroing out entire channels.

classes.name: Dropout3d
classes.description: Dropout variant for 3D feature maps, zeroing out entire channels.

classes.name: AlphaDropout
classes.description: Dropout that maintains the self-normalizing property, used with SELU activation.

classes.name: FeatureAlphaDropout
classes.description: Dropout that masks entire feature maps, setting activations to negative saturation of SELU.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for _DropoutNd, initializes dropout probability and inplace flag.

methods.name: extra_repr
methods.description: Returns string representation of dropout parameters.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the dropout operation on the input tensor.
